name: Local Amenity 2
definition: Contains additional information about the fuel location, such as hours of operation and Interstate Access/Exit Number, etc.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of additional service available. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

AvailableIndicator.name: Available Indicator
AvailableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not a specific type of amenity is available at this location.
